input_protocol: ready/valid completed descriptor; request_ready means adapter slot is available, not that descriptor fields are valid. Invalid consumed descriptors pulse rejected and increment a saturating counter.
ownership: Require bound, local bank 0..3, PENDING and not FROZEN, exact live owner_epoch/generation/capture_id/start_seq. OWNER_LOST status is rejected. No statistics, publish, discard, RAW ACK or replay lease is issued.
length: Use live bank sample_count, require 1<=actual<=requested<=16384. If actual differs or bank truncated is set, preserve actual length and set TRUNCATED.
id_policy: Allocate once for each valid consumed descriptor. 32-bit IDs start at 1 and never reset on source switch, epoch changes, bank reset, cancel or block. MAX_METADATA_ID defaults to UINT32_MAX; final ID accepted then exhausted until cold/session reset. Zero maximum disables allocation.
reset_policy: rst is cold/session reset only. Before restarting IDs, downstream must invalidate/drain old records and establish a new acquisition session/time epoch; this module has no persistent storage. Never wire bank soft reset to rst.
capacity: capacity_available is prospective capacity, not a reserved credit. Upstream admission controller must reserve the single slot or remain blocked until its earlier window completes. Current module is not yet wired into the instrument trigger path.
output: Atomic paired header and 96-byte sidecar via the existing encoder. Ownership is checked on acceptance; held output remains immutable across owner changes and requires downstream revalidation before RAW read/publish.
